wiki.title: Raghib Allie-Brennan
wiki.extract: Raghib Ismail Allie-Brennan (born July 20, 1991) is an American politician serving as a member of the Connecticut House of Representatives from the 2nd district, which encompasses most of Bethel and parts of Danbury, since 2019. In 2025, Allie-Brennan was arrested on two occasions and charged with shoplifting at a Target located in Bethel.
